caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden doll standing on a small rectangular platform. The doll has a pale complexion with faint pink cheeks and is wearing a beige dress that reaches just above the ankles, adorned with gold and brown trim. Over one shoulder, she has a golden sash with brown fringe. The doll has a red cap with white lace and feather decorations on her head, and her blonde hair is styled in ringlets peeking out from under the cap. She holds a small round brown bag in her left hand, suspended by a thin white string. The doll’s feet are painted green, resembling shoes, and she stands firmly on a square base with a brown border. The background is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Dairy Maid Doll
